open_questions: Sys_ConsoleInputInit calls 0x080b4980(ttycon, 0) right after registering ttycon with default 1, which looks like it forces tty console off; also reads tty_erase/tty_eof from a still-zeroed local termios. Both preserved; confirm with a runtime trace of the server on a tty.

Names of ~25 empty/return-0 stubs (e.g. 0x080d4372, 0x080d437e, 0x080d6bd0..0x080d6c2c) and the twin 0x080d65d4/0x080d661e (Sys_DefaultInstallPath vs Sys_DefaultBasePath) are unresolved; roles depend on callers via function pointer tables (no direct callers).

Sys_IsLANAddress (0x080d5638) and NET_BaseAdrToString (0x080d520a) read only the first two dwords of a netadr; whether callers pass netadr_t by value (20 bytes) or a different layout is unverified. Sys_FileTime/stat layout offset 0x40 is st_mtime of the glibc 2.3 i386 struct.

Sys_Chmod passes one argument to a two-conversion format ('chmod +%d '%s'') in the binary; kept verbatim. Cvar helper semantics (0x080b3fd2/0x080b4232/0x080b403a/0x080b4980) are inferred from names only until the cvar chunk merges.
